verdict.rationale: Remote documents official SDKs on a dedicated "Introduction to Remote SDKs" page. They let partners embed workflows such as cost calculators and onboarding flows, either as a custom UI or as customizable drop-in flows, and the developer portal points to sample apps and boilerplate to clone or fork. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose language client libraries (the documented SDKs appear to be UI and workflow embedding kits), package names or install details, API coverage depth, and independent hands-on corroboration.
